bestBets.overview: OFFICIAL BUSINESS showed ability in his initial preparation where he was close up in a couple of Saturday 2YO events. He's been tuned up for his return with two impressive trial efforts and expecting him to park right over the speed and go very close. STAR MARTINI led and was edged out late by a handy type first-up. She will be looking to find the front and is the one to rundown. GUNNING FOR GOLD makes his debut on the back of some encouraging trial efforts. SALVE REGINA next best.

raceTips.comment: Official Business has trialled super for his return and brings some impressive formlines from his debut prep, looks a nice Colt in the making with a map to boot. Star Martini looks the danger fresh off a month after kicking strongly and only being run down late by a horse who has performed well in Saturday company last start. Light weight and drawn to kick through and land right over the speed in running. Gunning For Gold has trialled like a horse who would be going close on debut but the barrier over the 1000m on debut is a leveller. Kute As Kan Be will look to kick through and hold out Star Martini early, back to the 1000m could be the key to her chances.

bestBets.overview: KEPPEL GATE makes her debut on the back of two sharp trial efforts. Expecting her to park close to the speed and run well.  JUNIPER has run well in her trials and W Pike rides. STAR SEED showed plenty of natural speed and tenacity in her recent trial win. SOVEREIGN ROCK rolls forward and gives a sight on the speed.

raceTips.comment: Day Out has trialled very impressively and shown some versatility in doing so for team Pearce. Also accepted for Saturday but if they go here think he looks ultra hard to beat with the shades on having trialled in them most recent and dominating his rivals from go to woah. Keppel Gate makes her debut for Simon Miller and has also impressed at the trials and also, shown versatility in what she's produced. Map looks a touch awkward? Star Seed looked very sharp in a recent trial win but the trial prior to that Day Out had her measure. Amalie's Rule was a huge improver second up after a plain debut and draws low for a back in-form Holly Nottle.

bestBets.overview: RETURN OF THE MACH should have finished closer first-up where he met interference in the straight. He improves off that run and W Pike retains the ride. YAMASHITA'S GOLD just missed behind a handy type at his local debut. If he repeats that effort he goes close again. FLASH DANCER produced back to back wins before stepping up in grade and finishing midfield. He will appreciate the drop back in class. KATONA will park off the speed and find the line well.

raceTips.comment: As open a race as you'll find. Yamashita's Gold only peaked very late after looming the winner and ran a cracker on WA debut. Great use of the claim and if he improves second up & handles a wet deck, should be going close. Return Of The Mach surprisingly stays at 1100m but in saying that, should of finished closer (or arguably won?) first up through that same race. Big positive Pike sticking. Flash Dancer brings that Lord Shiva form which is going to be very popular for many off the back of back-to-back wins prior, bit of weight though? Last Stylebender is well placed out of competitive efforts in Saturday company utilising the Giaan O'Donnell claim, should be in-front for a very long way but could tiptoe late at the 1100m.

bestBets.overview: Keen on SAISOKU in this maiden. He stormed home first-up and then last start he led and was just worn down late by a handy type. He should be primed for this at his third run back from a spell and from gate 1 he can lead or box seat and get every chance. SECRETCHINO battled on well last start after parking wide throughout MOMOTARO has been fair in both starts. CRAZY CARROT next best.

raceTips.comment: Saisoku won't find an easier race to be breaking through than this. Returned in career best order and if he runs up to either of his two efforts already this campaign he'll be winning, deservingly short. Kambula kept finding on debut and should only improve, brings some upside. Parish Play was better last start and now CJP jumps on, like that appointment. Daisiesfortheladys hasn't fired a shot for a while but ran some cheeky races in her debut prep which would be good enough to be competitive here.

bestBets.overview: SECRET PLANET was a sharp trial winner back in May and then was asked for little in his recent trial in August. W Pike rides and expecting him to be hard to hard to beat. UNANSWERED ran well first-up where he was beaten a nice type. He improves off that run and has claims. MY MALENA ran well on debut and draws to get every chance. LONG LAUGH rolls forward and has claims.

raceTips.comment: Secret Planet just trialled like a nice horse, plain and simple. Led and bolted in back in May, tipped out, and loved the way he worked home very quietly most recent for a powerful combination. Drawn perfectly to give Pike options, expecting a very forward showing on debut. Unanswered looks another nice 3YO who wound up strongly late on return behind a very impressive subsequent winner on Wednesday, 1300m should suit. My Malena got under the guard on debut and ran a cracker behind what looks a nice horse in Big Red Zoom, 1000m straight to 1300m here and looks a genuine key contender. Long Laugh is knocking on the door.

bestBets.overview: TAG TIME was edged out by his stable mate in his local debut ( that horse was a subsequent winner). The blinkers go on, he draws to get every chance and Pike rides. PROFOUND BENEFIT has been sound in both starts this time in and should be peaking. LET'S GO JARPO has shown ability in his career and the blinkers go on. MYSTIC EMPRESS next best.

raceTips.comment: Tag Time is going to polarise some price-wise. Scratched twice for elevated temperatures over the last 35 days since we saw him but the fact he's here you have to take the team on trust that he's ready to go. Huge on WA debut behind a horse who then won a CL1 and ran well in Saturday company, shades on, drawn well, should be very, very hard to beat despite the fact he'll go around vehemently short in the market. Profound Benefit has hit the line super in both runs back this campaign in a couple of handy maiden form references, has had a few chances now though. Mystic Empress was stiff to get the flick from the Lane Train! Now joins Phil Naylor and reckon if she ran up to 2 of her last 3 runs she'd be very competitive here. Is 6 weeks between runs however now and the barrier is a blow. Free Ride was a bit unlucky last start but was never winning.

bestBets.overview: MISS VEUVE was slow away, settled at the tail and made good late ground at her most recent start. Brad Parnham going on is a big plus and she should appreciate the rise in trip.  LUKA MAGIC battled on well last start overt this trip. He should get every chance from a good draw and run well. CONSOLIDATED was a tough maiden winner at his last start.  HISTORY SUPREME gives the impression he will be suited with the rise in trip.

raceTips.comment: Luka Magic dropped on them late to win his maiden over 2200m then stepped straight into a midweek 54+ and more than held his own behind a horse that would start $1.40 in this field in Wild Things. Great race for him back into a CL1 staying event to post another win. Stolen wasn't far behind Luka in that same race behind Wild Things two back. Terrible last start and a little wayward, but happy to be forgiving of one bad run and seemed to get on well with Tash Faithfull. Miss Veuve won't find a more suitable race to post the second win of her career but knowing her well enough by now she'll find a way to throw it away. History Supreme gives every indication this'll be his sort of trip and gets shades on, just not sure he's an apprentices horse?

bestBets.overview: SURROUND ME has run well in both starts this time in and should be peaking at her third run back from a spell. She draws to get every chance and Pike rides. DIAMOND WARRIOR is racing well and just needs some luck from his wide draw to play a part. CATCH CARTER rolls forward and gives a kick. SUPER SENTAI narrowly shook his maiden tag first-up. No surprise to see him improve off that and run well again.

raceTips.comment: Surround Me should be very hard to beat. Closed off well in the key form reference race for this last start behind Swansee on a day where it was very difficult to make ground. Third up, drawn a gate, 1300m, tick tick tick. Catch Carter was up on speed in that same race and kept punching, very hard to catch if left alone in front and can get there comfortably enough. Ocean Goddess resumes after working to the line well in a handy little trial, reckon she'll need at least one but she's got good ability. Hyperreal was very strong late behind Cinque Stelle only two starts ago and draws a gate here, improver. My Jimmy becomes the on-topper if he gets a run just about? Big watch Thursday morning.
